ev.q: During August 14–December 1, a total of 52 EKC cases were identified
Dates of symptom onset in 52 patients with epidemic keratoconjunctivitis (EKC)
HAdV-8 was detected in 10 of 12 patient specimens
The local health department, with support from WVBPH, conducted an investigation to determine the source

methods_quotes.q: Practice-associated cases were ascertained by medical record review.
The Wadsworth Laboratory, New York State Department of Health, confirmed HAdV presence with real-time polymerase chain reaction
